provenance.sourceClassification: AI-generated stylized concept boards (see the source kits)
provenance.derivativeClassification: deterministically pixelified keys, posed by a cut-out rig
provenance.derivation: Every frame is one source key re-rendered through a two-part cut-out rig (Scale2x x3 + nearest-neighbour rotation, no new colours, binary alpha). The kits' keys are the only full pose changes; rig-posed moving holds fill the clips to the 20-30 unique-frame standard.
